exposure: age of children 6 years and above
history of recurrent allergy and rhinitis
cohort: 152 children attending Kanti Children's Hospital, Kathmandu, Nepal, and their parents.
finding: Several factors were associated with childhood asthma, including older child age, lack of exclusive breastfeeding, history of recurrent allergy and rhinitis, influenza vaccination, maternal history of asthma, and presence of dampness at home.
